fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) closed at $534.06 on November 13, down 8.75%, and despite a 30% three-week surge in per-share terms, recorded declines within the week due to rotation pressure in the AI chip sector.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue of $13.4 billion and nearly doubled data center revenue showed strength, but ongoing volatility is expected ahead of next week's Nvidia earnings and AI chip demand uncertainties.
